facts.fact: 他满脑子只有与 Emily 的约定。
facts.anchor: His promised evening with Emily was all he cared about now.

facts.fact: Emily 的信 12 月 30 日到，他抢在妻子前拿走。
facts.anchor: Her letter arrived on 30 December. He recognised her childlike script from her terrible essays, and snatched it from the doormat before his wife could spot it.

facts.fact: 稚气笔迹让他想起中学生的情书。
facts.anchor: Here she had attempted to draw a pair of Champagne flutes, but the smudged Biro sketch more closely resembled two cricket bats. The word ‘fun’ was underlined three times. As letters went, it was juvenile and brought to mind the note a younger teenager might slip into the schoolbag of the boy she fancied.

facts.fact: 信封藏在旧红 T 恤里、抽屉最深处。

facts.anchor: Emily hadn’t indulged his other request.
